notes:
## 0.2.353

owes: none — a loopback test hub (SPEC-220): the Release also carries `synchub-server-<version>.zip` and its `.sha256` beside the engine zip, `bin/synchub-server --test-hub` starts a throwaway hub on 127.0.0.1 with TLS, its own certificate, no egress and a refusal in the image (SPEC-089 D51), and `synchub-engine --ask <requests> --out <answers>` runs a request file with no socket; no key, default, migration or collection changes, the image starts as before (its entry point passes no argument), and a rollback loses nothing; the image's jar carries the small synthetic data set under `/synthetic/`, read only by `--test-hub --seed synthetic`.
owes: none
owes: the weather module's alert markers (heavy rain, strong wind) now follow the owner's own alert settings, synced from WeatherScraper in `weather.settings`, through DataCore's `alertsFor` (SPEC-015, DUP-75), in place of the fixed 70 % rain probability and 50 km/h wind: a day is marked at the amounts WeatherScraper's notifier uses at the chosen sensitivity (heavy rain from 20 mm, strong wind from 60 km/h at *Normal*), a city or a category the owner switched off is not marked, and the per-hour rain marker is gone. WeatherScraper's alerts are off until the owner switches them on, so an account whose phone never did sees no marker: switch *Weather alerts* on in WeatherScraper and let it sync.
owes: none — the forecast API's query and decoder and the place search are DataCore's now (SPEC-015, DUP-71): the daily humidity is requested, stored and carried to the phones, so a place the hub fetched shows its humidity on the phone too; the place search always asks for English names, so its region line reads *region, country* as WeatherScraper's does; a forecast API answer that names no coordinates is now unreadable (the real service always names them); nothing for the user or the person shipping it to do.

owes: none — `/static/note-drag.js` (SPEC-219 §8) captures the pointer on the card's list, never the card, so a drag past another card no longer snaps back; the script's bytes change, so its CSP hash changes with them (computed from the shipped file), and nothing else moves; no operator or user action.

owes: none — the stocks instrument page's year block names its own target (`hx-target="this"`, SPEC-216 §report 2026-11-21): loading the year no longer replaces the whole column, and the page keeps its head, chart and period row; a web page's markup, no route, key, default or migration change.

owes: none — re-pinned tooling 0.1.107 → 0.1.108

owes: none — re-pinned tooling 0.1.105 → 0.1.107: the release and repin actions and the tooling submodule move to v0.1.107; its changes are the test bench's report and its tests (`bench/`, SPEC-009), nothing a hub or its operator runs.
